name: quit-empty-no-palette
description: Prediction test, the FAIL half - and the regression guard the bug actually needs. Same as quit-with-tab except the space has NO tabs, so browser_->tab_strip_model()->active_index() == kNoTab and BrowserCommandController::ExecuteCommandWithDisposition returns true at browser_command_controller.cc:629 WITHOUT running Exit(). AtriumBrowserWindow::ExecuteCommand then returns its unconditional true, upstream's prePerformKeyEquivalent reports kHandled, and Atrium's own Cmd+Q -> kPassToMainMenu fallback in postPerformKeyEquivalent never runs. seed_prefs pre-empts the first-run search picker, which is what ate the Escape in quit-no-palette; the vlog gate below is what stops this passing vacuously through the palette's route the way empty-window-quit has been.

actions.note: long enough that the auto-opened palette is definitely up before the dismiss attempts - measured 3.9-5.0s from launch on this VM
first dismiss attempt. Observed unreliable on its own: it dismissed in quit-sidebar-focus but not in quit-no-palette or the first quit-empty-no-palette run, so the scrim click below backs it up
give the Escape time to land before trying the other dismiss path

second dismiss attempt: the palette's scrim covers the window, and a press outside the panel is the same 'command bar dismiss op (Escape/scrim)' path. Bottom-right corner, far from the centred panel (quit-content-focus proved 620,430 is still ON the panel) and clear of the 280px sidebar
let the palette close and key focus return to the browser window
evidence the palette is really gone before Cmd+Q

assertions.label: palette-dismissed
assertions.note: GATE: proves the palette actually closed. Without it the quit passes through atrium_command_bar_widget.mm's kPassToMainMenu route and never tests the browser window at all - which is how empty-window-quit stayed green over a live bug through two closes.

assertions.desc: Cmd+Q quits a TABLESS window with the palette closed - the browser window's own path

assertions.label: not-the-palette-route
assertions.pattern: Atrium: palette passing key-equivalent to main menu
assertions.note: Listed AFTER the quit assertion on purpose: the run log is pulled before assertions run, so a line Cmd+Q itself emits is only in the log that assert_quit re-pulls. Placed before it, this gate could never match - and a vlog_absent one would pass trivially, which is exactly the vacuous shape to avoid.
